blockers.finding: Planner expects a valid Prediction with tokens >512 to trigger decomposition. Predictor instead raises text_limit before DP and exits the serve loop; even if worker returned oversized tokens, DurationSession rejects the result and closes. NaturalTTS propagates this error instead of splitting. This is safe rejection, not functional dynamic-input fallback.

executed_reproduction.method: Verified source manifest, used actual SDK UnicodeProcessor and a DP sentinel that must never execute; called real planner with real Predictor.

blockers.required_fix: Introduce a bounded structured over-token rejection/count response without executing DP above 512; preserve session and let planner decompose. Test the real planner-session-worker protocol seam, both normal and -O, not a mock Prediction alone. Keep tokens512 native admission guard unchanged.

blockers.finding: DP predicts the full text including blank-line paragraphs as one context; planner accepts it when within DP limits. SDK chunker always emits separate paragraphs even under max_chunk_length=800. Native preflight correctly rejects multiple SDK chunks, so valid paragraph-containing replies fail after planning.

executed_reproduction.method: Real planner with harmless bounded Prediction, actual pinned SDK chunk_text; existing native-worker fixture independently verifies rejection before synthesis.

blockers.required_fix: Align planner/DP context with exact SDK paragraph behavior, or explicitly use a reviewed one-context SDK path without lexical changes. Preserve exact original source spans, fixed delivery, per-native bounds; add vertical paragraph regression.
